        tss=start if strand=='+' else end
        # keep longest/one
        if name not in gene_info:
            gene_info[name]=(chrom,start,end,strand,tss)
# compute gene body and promoter sums
prom_up=2000; prom_down=2000
P=np.zeros((len(genes),8)); B=np.zeros((len(genes),8)); N=[]
for i,g in enumerate(genes):
    if g not in gene_info:
        N.append(0); continue
    chrom,start,end,strand,tss=gene_info[g]
    pr_start=tss-prom_up; pr_end=tss+prom_down
    idx=[]
    for j,(c,s,e) in enumerate(coords):
        if c==chrom and e>pr_start and s<pr_end:
            idx.append(j)
    body_idx=[]
    for j,(c,s,e) in enumerate(coords):
        if c==chrom and e>start and s<end:
            body_idx.append(j)

    else:
        N.append(0)

        B[i]=A[body_idx].sum(axis=0)

            corrsp[r,a]=st.spearmanr(x,y)[0]
    print('pearson log1p')
    for r in range(8):
        print(r, np.round(corr[r],3), 'best', np.argsort(corr[r])[::-1][:3])
    # hungarian maximize sum
    from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
    ri,ci=linear_sum_assignment(-corr)
    print('assignment', list(zip(ri,ci)), 'total', corr[ri,ci].sum(), 'perm', ci)
    print('spearman')

import gzip, bisect, re, math
from collections import defaultdict
# pure helper
def load(fn):
    rows=[]; names=[]
    with gzip.open(fn,'rt') as f:
        h=f.readline().strip().split('\\t')
        for line in f:
            p=line.strip().split('\\t'); names.append(p[0]); rows.append([float(x) for x in p[1:]])
    return names,rows,h
# data only once
genes,R,_=load('inputs/multiome.match.atac.rna.q1.rna.tsv.gz')
peaks,A,_=load('inputs/multiome.match.atac.rna.q1.atac.tsv.gz')
coords=[]
for p in peaks:
    m=re.match(r'(chr[\\w]+)_(\\d+)_(\\d+)',p); coords.append((m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))))
byc=defaultdict(lambda:[[],[]])
for j,(c,s,e) in enumerate(coords):
    byc[c][0].append(s); byc[c][1].append(j)
for c in byc:
    order=sorted(range(len(byc[c][0])), key=lambda k:byc[c][0][k])
    byc[c][0]=[byc[c][0][o] for o in order]; byc[c][1]=[byc[c][1][o] for o in order]
def intervals(chrom,s,e):
    if chrom not in byc: return []
    starts,idx=byc[chrom]
    lo=bisect.bisect_left(starts,s-10000); hi=bisect.bisect_left(starts,e)
    out=[]
    for k in range(lo,hi):
        j=idx[k]; cs,ce=coords[j][1],coords[j][2]
        if ce>s and cs<e: out.append(j)
    return out
def load_ref(fn):
    gi={}
    with gzip.open(fn,'rt') as f:
        for line in f:
            p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
            if len(p)<13: continue
            name=p[12]; chrom=p[2]; strand=p[3]; start=int(p[4]); end=int(p[5]); tss=start if strand=='+' else end
            if name not in gi: gi[name]=(chrom,start,end,tss)
    return gi
def activity(ref_fn):
    gi=load_ref(ref_fn)
    P=[[0.0]*8 for _ in genes]; mapped=0
    for i,g in enumerate(genes):
        if g not in gi: continue
        chrom,start,end,tss=gi[g]
        idx=intervals(chrom,max(0,tss-2000),tss+2000)
        if idx:
            mapped+=1
            for j in idx:
                row=A[j]
                for c in range(8): P[i][c]+=row[c]
    return P,mapped,gi
def corr_and_assign(P):
    # pearson log1p, keep genes with any activity
    X=[];Y=[]
    for i in range(len(genes)):
        if sum(P[i])>0:
            X.append(R[i]);Y.append(P[i])
    n=len(X)
    mat=[[0.0]*8 for _ in range(8)]
    for r in range(8):
        for a in range(8):
            lx=[math.log1p(X[i][r]) for i in range(n)]
            ly=[math.log1p(Y[i][a]) for i in range(n)]
            mx=sum(lx)/n; my=sum(ly)/n
            cov=sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(lx,ly))
            vx=sum((x-mx)**2 for x in lx); vy=sum((y-my)**2 for y in ly)
            mat[r][a]=cov/math.sqrt(vx*vy)
    # brute force assignment max sum
    import itertools
    best=None;bs=-1e9
    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(8)):
        s=sum(mat[i][perm[i]] for i in range(8))
        if s>bs: bs=s;best=perm
    return mat,best,bs,n
for ref in ['/workspace/refs/refGene.txt.gz','/workspace/refs/refGene.hg19.txt.gz']:
    P,mapped,gi=activity(ref)
    mat,best,s,n=corr_and_assign(P)
    print('\\n',ref,'mapped',mapped,'genes tested',n,'assign',best,'sum',round(s,3))
    print('matrix')
    for r in range(8): print(r, [round(mat[r][a],3) for a in range(8)])
